paragraphs.text: Ouramos is the dryad domain of Deepwood forest on Mercadia .

Ouramos is a set of overgrown ruins riddling the eastern reaches of Deepwood, interspersed with trees and heavy vegetation, including creeper plants and vines. It prominently features the circular crater containing the Henge of Ramos .
The Henge of Ramos - a crater collecting mana

In 4205 AR, nine of the Weatherlight crew traveled through Ouramos seeking the Henge of Ramos . When they found the crater, a vine dryad attack drove them back, entangling them in metal-hard vines and making sludge and mud out of the ground. Both Ilcaster and Tallakaster were killed in this manner, until Gerrard Capashen offered the dryads subservience by sitting down, allowing them to create a connection with him. Telepathically bonding with the chieftain of the dryads , Gerrard shared his story and intentions with the forest and in return was told the origin story of Ramos . After the surviving crew had obtained the Bones of Ramos , they returned to Ouramos to find that the powerstones lost their luster when away from the dragon engine . Aided by the dryads and their chief, they collected the conscience of the Deepwood to light the powerstones long enough to reach the Power Matrix . However, when they woke up the next day, they found that Takara (really Volrath in disguise) had stolen the gems and escaped back to Mercadia City .
